question: What is full name of the racer who ranked 1st in the 3rd qualifying race held in the Marina Bay Street Circuit in 2008?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname
FROM drivers_circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE T3.circuitId = (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM drivers_circuits
    WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND T3.year = 2008
  AND T3.round = 3
  AND T2.position = 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT dc.forename, dc.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers_circuits dc ON q.driverId = dc.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers_circuits dc2 ON r.circuitId = dc2.circuitId
WHERE r.year = 2008
  AND dc2.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1
